title: Deleting an Issue from the Entra ID Issue Safelist

blocks.text: You can remove an issue from the Entra ID Issue Safelist.
To remove the issue from Entra ID Issue Safelist:

blocks.item: Go to ITDR > Settings > Entra ID Issue Safelist.
Select an Entra ID tenant from the Result for drop-down menu.
Under Actions, click the Delete icon to remove the issue from the safelist.
In the confirmation window, click OK.
The issue is added to the Focus Area page and is included in the new and previous vulnerability reports for the tenant.
